topic: Write a Brief Report on People's Beliefs about Adventure(写一篇关于人们对探险看法的简短报告)
genre: 调查报告 / 说明(report survey results using statistics as supporting details)
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 3 Writing:writing a brief report on people's beliefs about adventure,用统计数字作为支撑细节(Writing Strategy: using statistics as supporting details)。
prompt_cn: 你在班里做了一次关于'探险对你意味着什么'的小调查。请用英语写一篇约90-110词的简短报告,内容包括:① 用一句总体陈述说明同学们对探险的总体态度;② 用具体的百分比数字描述至少两类不同看法(如'见识新事物''高风险活动''说走就走的旅行'等);③ 用一句话作结。注意:数字要具体、相关、清楚,用来支撑你的陈述。
prompt_en: You have done a mini-survey in class about what adventure means to your classmates. Write a brief report (about 90-110 words) including: 1) a general statement about your classmates' overall attitude towards adventure; 2) specific percentages describing at least two different views (e.g. seeing something new, highly risky activities, travelling on a budget); 3) a concluding sentence. Use statistics that are specific, relevant and clear to support your statement.
points: 总体陈述(The majority of my classmates … / Most of my classmates hold a … attitude)
用具体百分比描述不同看法(45.2% of them said …; 26.8% described it as …)
数字具体、相关、清楚(避免 'more than half',用 '52.4%')
结尾句总结(It can thus be seen that …)
model_essay: Last week I carried out a mini-survey in our class to find out what adventure means to my classmates. The results show that most of them hold a positive attitude towards adventure. As the figures show, 45.2% of the students said adventure meant "seeing and doing something new", while 28.6% described it as "getting off the beaten track and visiting unusual places". A smaller group, 16.7%, believed adventure was "taking part in highly risky activities", and only 9.5% related it to "travelling on a budget". It can thus be seen that, to most of my classmates, adventure is more about new experiences than about danger.
model_translation: 上周我在班里做了一次小调查,想弄清探险对同学们意味着什么。结果显示大多数同学对探险持积极态度。数据表明,45.2%的同学认为探险意味着'见识并尝试新事物',28.6%把它描述为'走人迹罕至之路、去不寻常的地方'。较少的一部分,即16.7%,认为探险是'参加高风险活动',只有9.5%把它与'省钱旅行'联系起来。由此可见,对大多数同学而言,探险更多关乎新体验,而非危险。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:总体陈述 / 至少两类带具体百分比的看法 / 结论句
报告体例清楚:陈述—数据支撑—结论;数字具体相关清楚、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、被动/数据表达得当、语法基本无误

error_pairs.wrong: More than half students think so.
error_pairs.correct: More than half of the students think so.
error_pairs.note: half of the + 复数名词;数字报告中更宜用具体百分比如 52.4%。

error_pairs.wrong: 45.2% of students said adventure mean new things.
error_pairs.correct: 45.2% of the students said adventure meant new things.
error_pairs.note: 宾语从句用过去时 meant;百分比后通常加 of the。

error_pairs.wrong: The survey was carry out last week.
error_pairs.correct: The survey was carried out last week.
error_pairs.note: 被动语态 be + 过去分词 carried out。
